capabilities: Convert Markdown notes to WeChat and Toutiao article HTML
Preview styled output at desktop and phone widths
Copy inline-styled rich HTML to the clipboard
Embed local vault images as Base64
Create and edit custom themes with typography, color, and spacing settings
disambiguation: Not a publishing or auto-posting tool; it only copies styled HTML for manual pasting into platform editors and calls no platform APIs.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README mixes plugin documentation with generic plugin-submission and CI/release instructions, and documents limitations such as Base64 images not auto-uploading on some platforms and pseudo-element styles being preview-only.
problem: WeChat and Toutiao editors strip class-based and stylesheet CSS, so Markdown notes pasted from Obsidian lose their formatting.
summary: Markdown-to-publishing converter that renders notes in WeChat Official Account or Toutiao styles and copies inline-styled rich HTML for pasting into those editors.
